paragraphs.text: Our client, Mrs. Maria Fernandes, has remained in continuous, settled possession of Plot Survey No. 44/2, Sub-Division 3, Mapusa, North Goa since February 2009 pursuant to an Agreement of Sale and General Power of Attorney.

Under Suraj Lamp & Industries v. State of Haryana, an unregistered agreement of sale or general power of attorney does not convey title by itself; however, possession and consideration paid entitle our client to seek execution of a registered conveyance and protection pending adjudication.

sources.title: Suraj Lamp & Industries v. State of Haryana
sources.snippet: Immovable property can be legally and lawfully transferred/conveyed only by a registered deed of conveyance. Transactions of the nature of 'GPA sales' or 'SA/GPA/WILL transfers' do not convey title.

paragraphs.locked_out_claim: Continuous possession since 2009 under an unregistered GPA automatically confers absolute ownership title.
